journey.name: closing a lightning connection returns to the connections list
journey.description:
Verifies the iOS route after a successful cooperative channel close. Use the local E2E Docker/LND fixture and an existing funded, usable Lightning connection. Start on Lightning Connections with the connection visible. Creating or funding the fixture is a prerequisite.
Closing returns directly to the connections list, so reloading the removed connection's detail cannot replace the success toast with "Connection Not Found". This journey checks navigation and acknowledgement; it does not establish settlement or final transfer balance.

actions.action: Verify "Transfer Initiated" appears and the current screen is Lightning Connections
Verify "Connection Not Found" does not appear after the success toast disappears
